recorded.letter:
**PRIOR AUTHORIZATION DETERMINATION**

**Decision: DENIED**

**Service:** Continuous Glucose Monitor  
**Order Date:** April 14, 2025

---

**Criteria Analysis:**

**Diagnosis (MET):** Type 1 diabetes mellitus documented since November 2016 (E10.9).

**Medical Need (MET):** Patient is on active insulin therapy—insulin glargine 22 units at bedtime, initiated August 30, 2023.

**Recent Evaluation (NOT MET):** The most recent diabetes follow-up visit with Dr. R. Castillo occurred on September 22, 2024. This visit is 204 days prior to your order date. Our policy requires an in-person or approved telehealth visit with the treating practitioner evaluating diabetes control within 6 months (183 days) of the order. Your visit falls outside this window by 21 days.

---

**To Proceed:**

Please schedule and document a new in-person or telehealth visit with the treating practitioner within 6 months of April 14, 2025, where diabetes control is evaluated. Submit the visit note and any relevant clinical findings (glucose logs, HbA1c results, or other diabetes management data) with a resubmitted authorization request.

Please contact us if you have questions.
